title: Sha'arei Orah (Hebrew, Italian manuscript)
author: Joseph Gikatilla
description: Joseph Gikatilla's Gates of Light in a Hebrew manuscript witness. The work explores divine names and the sefirot, connecting scriptural language with the symbolic structure of Kabbalistic thought.
